services.purpose: Serves the owner's approved read-only media library through a private web interface.

acceptance.description: Complete the first-owner wizard manually with username admin and the generated project password. The app-local HTTP adapter subsequently verifies exact administrator policy and IsStartupWizardCompleted; it never scripts the unproven untouched-state transition.

After manual bootstrap, verify one checkpoint-bound project-labeled persistent Auth/Keys token, save it privately before protected readback, and reject duplicate, inactive, incomplete, or ambiguous inventories without replay.
Select only directories under the approved read-only mount and verify indexing and playback.
Restart only this owned service and recheck administrator login, library paths, and playback.
